KGS Hauler IV.name: KGS Hauler IV
KGS Hauler IV.description: Although the Hauler, Hauler II, and Hauler III are more popular, the Hauler IV is still used by many, for its low price, durable hull, and excellent cargo space. It is, however, very slow.

KGS Hauler V.name: KGS Hauler V
KGS Hauler V.description: The Hauler V has even more cargo space than the Hauler IV, but it is even slower. It is, however, very durable.

KGS Hauler VI.name: KGS Hauler VI
KGS Hauler VI.description: The Hauler VI has an incredible amount of cargo space, but it is equally slow. It is only used because it is cheaper than two Hauler IIIs.

KGS Hauler VII.name: KGS Hauler VII
KGS Hauler VII.description: The Hauler VII is the largest freighter built by Southbound Shipyards. It lives up to its title with over 900 tons of cargo space, while being cheaper than multiple smaller freighters.

KGS Maker.name: KGS Maker
KGS Maker.description: A Rainmaker without its missile launchers, the Maker is a sturdy but sluggish interceptor. Because of its decreased firepower, the Maker is available to regular civilians for purchase.

KGS Dipper.name: KGS Dipper
KGS Dipper.description: The Dipper is a light warship and freighter cobbled together from two Clipper hulls. Seven gun ports and a spacious cargo hold make it a desirable ship among merchants and pirates in the South.

KGS Mistmaker.name: KGS Mistmaker
KGS Mistmaker.description: The Mistmaker is lighter version of the Rainmaker missile boat, built for civilian use. It comes equipped with four missile pods and enough ammunition to destroy even ships many times its size, and is also slightly faster than the Rainmaker.

KGS Nightingale.name: KGS Nightingale
KGS Nightingale.description: The Nightingale is a modified Raven with 24 gun ports. Such a huge modification resulted in lowered shield efficiency and hull structural integrity, along with higher drag and worse heat dissipation.

KGS Sparrowhawk.name: KGS Sparrowhawk
KGS Sparrowhawk.description: Tarazed's Sparrowhawk-class light warship was made by mashing together their interceptors, the Hawk and the Sparrow. The result is a powerful ship, with six guns and decent mobility. It has become very popular as an affordable escort for captains fending off pirates in the South.

KGS BIG PEW PEW.name: KGS BIG PEW PEW
KGS BIG PEW PEW.description: The Lionheart Raven is their most popular warship, an agile and elegant vessel that can nevertheless deal out and absorb considerable damage. Ravens are a favorite ship for bounty hunters, because they are more than a match for pirate interceptors and can be used by a skilled pilot to take down much larger ships as well.

KGS Eyas.name: KGS Eyas
KGS Eyas.description: A shortened Kingfisher, the Eyas-class Destroyer is the fastest medium warship in the Southern Rim, although it is somewhat undergunned.

KGS Eyrie.name: KGS Eyrie
KGS Eyrie.description: The Lionheart Eyrie is a light carrier derived from the Aerie. The Aerie's four internal fighter bays have been rearranged into six drone bays, which are commonly found carrying Lionheart's Stiletto drones.

KGS Stormmaker.name: KGS Stormmaker
KGS Stormmaker.description: The Stormmaker is a heavy missile platform derived from the Rainmaker missile boat. It comes equipped with twelve missile launchers and enough ammunition to destroy ships many times its size. However, it is still slow, and its backup non-missile armament is still very weak.

KGS Kingfisher.name: KGS Kingfisher
KGS Kingfisher.description: A Falcon without its side pods, the Kingfisher-class Battlecruiser is faster and even sleeker, at the cost of weapon space and hardpoints. It has been adapted to use strike tactics, flying fast at the target and unloading a flurry of plasma fire and Javelins before retreating for another dive.

KGS Kookaburra.name: KGS Kookaburra
KGS Kookaburra.description: Tarazed Shipyards created this monstrosity as a competitor to the Syndicate Protector. A Kingfisher has been stretched, and 10 extra turrets have been added. What it lacks in affordability it makes up for in mobility - upgraded engines allow it to go alarmingly fast for a 12 turret ship.

KGS Fallcoon.name: KGS Fallcoon
KGS Fallcoon.description: The Tarazed Fallcoon was designed as a competitor to Southbound Shipyards' Dreadnought. Its twin Falcon hulls boast huge engine bays and a staggering array of Plasma Cannons. Although its design was completed too late for it to take part in the civil war, it is still a terrifying warship, able to go head-to-head with a Cruiser.

KGS Raindrop.name: KGS Raindrop
KGS Raindrop.description: The Raindrop is a light missile drone built in the Republic Navy Yard, equipped with two missile launchers. Because of its extremely frail hull and lack of shielding, Raindrops serve best as long-range attack drones, and once their missile supply is spent, they are useless in combat.

KGS Stiletto.name: KGS Stiletto
KGS Stiletto.description: The Stiletto is a drone developed by Lionheart, derived from the Dagger fighter. As with almost all Lionheart ships, its hull is very light. A potent shield matrix along with long range missile pods give it above average survivability for a drone. 	Drones do not come equipped with a hyperdrive. You cannot carry a drone unless you have a ship in your fleet with a drone bay.

KGS Yestrel.name: KGS Yestrel
KGS Yestrel.description: Two years after the design of the Kestrel, Tarazed's chief ship designer has finally completed the design of a ship even more powerful, the Yestrel.

KGS Biolofez.name: KGS Biolofez
KGS Biolofez.description: The Biolofez was made by integrating the hulls of two salvaged 'olofez. The result is a quite capable interceptor. Due to its low fuel capacity and lack of shield generation, the Remnant use it only for patrol and point defense.

KGS Triolofez.name: KGS Triolofez
KGS Triolofez.description: A Biolofez with another 'olofez tacked on, the Triolofez is a very powerful interceptor. However, its low fuel capacity combined with the fact that the Remnant do not make dedicated shield generation or hull repair have relegated it to in-system patrol and point defense.

KGS Yolofez.name: KGS Yolofez
KGS Yolofez.description: The Yolofez is two 'olofez hulls put together, but with the cockpit of the upper 'olofez modified into a turret mount. The result is a good interceptor. However, due to its low fuel capacity and lack of recovery systems, the Remnant use it only for patrol and point defense.

KGS Silver Penguin.name: KGS Silver Penguin
KGS Silver Penguin.description: Inspired by close contact with void sprites and the reinvigoration of xenobiology, the Penguin is a prototype designed to serve the dual roles of testing new starship technology while exploring hostile planets throughout the Ember Waste. One of this ship's distinguishing features is that it is truly alive and has a mind that approaches self-awareness. 	The cloaking technology is built into the Penguin's hull; it cannot be removed or transferred to another ship.

KGS Silver Puffin.name: KGS Silver Puffin
KGS Silver Puffin.description: Centuries ago, the Remnant built these ships in order to explore the upper atmosphere of nearby gas giants. The Archons took issue with the Remnant's research methods, and the studies were unable to be completed. The remaining Puffins have been gathering dust in storage for centuries while the Remnant wait to see if the anger of the Archons will subside.

KGS Silver Gull.name: KGS Silver Gull
KGS Silver Gull.description: While the Starling was the first successful ship to use technology derived from alien ruins, the Gull is the most recent. The current increase in Korath activities has caused foraging for resources to become a risky endeavor, forcing the Remnant to develop a specialized freighter for hauling cargo from remote sites without revealing their presence to hostile aliens. 	The Gull has quickly proven its worth, allowing the Starling fleets to return to riskier activities while the Gull takes over the hazardous convoy routes. It is now the primary element of the Remnant's extra-territorial resource operations. 	The cloaking technology is built into the Gull's hull; it cannot be removed or transferred to another ship.

KGS Silver Pelican.name: KGS Silver Pelican
KGS Silver Pelican.description: The Pelican is closely based on the original semi-organic materials the Remnant found in the Ember Waste. While they are not technically alive, their internal mechanisms and method of construction bear such a close resemblance to living organisms that they are often considered as such. One key feature of this living resemblance is the innate sensory capabilities they possess, akin to sensor suites less advanced ships require for detailed scanning. These ships serve as the backbone of Remnant bulk salvage efforts, as well as their fast-logistics distribution network.

KGS Silver Merganser.name: KGS Silver Merganser
KGS Silver Merganser.description: The Merganser is the first production ship the Remnant deem to be truly alive, and are considered to be equivalent to dolphins in reasoning tests. These interceptors, deemed for short range operations by Remnant standards, are designed to patrol the upper atmosphere of gas giants and use their decisive speed advantage to conduct hit-and-run attacks on threats in nearby systems. 	The cloaking technology is built into the Merganser's hull; it cannot be removed or transferred to another ship.

KGS Silver Starling.name: KGS Silver Starling
KGS Silver Starling.description: One of the strangest and most useful things that the Remnant have discovered in the abandoned worlds of the Ember Waste is alien cloaking technology. They have designed their scout ships to cloak when needed in order to explore alien territory without being seen... or to escape in a hurry after stealing something particularly valuable from those aliens. 	The cloaking technology is built into the Starling's hull; it cannot be removed or transferred to another ship.

KGS Silver Ibis.name: KGS Silver Ibis
KGS Silver Ibis.description: The Ibis is a multipurpose carrier that serves as a mobile mining platform, an escort ship for Pelican fleets, and a combat platform using Terns for screening. It is capable of fielding a single wing of support craft, consisting of two Petrels and four Terns. 	The Ibis was designed shortly after the Albatross as a means of extending the range of resource collection efforts after the Remnant realized that an Alpha invasion might not be as imminent as originally believed.

KGS Silver Peregrine.name: KGS Silver Peregrine
KGS Silver Peregrine.description: The Peregrine is the first capital warship designed by Taely using fresh insights garnered from recent experimentation as well as renewed studies of the void sprites. Encompassing over a century of development since the last generation of warships was built, it is the forerunner of a new breed of Remnant ships. 	The Peregrine was designed along the lines of old-earth's fast-attack cruisers. Drawing on inspiration from its namesake, famed for being the fastest self-propelled lifeform on Earth, it is designed to strike hard and fast. It closes quickly with enemies to unleash devastating barrages in the opening seconds of combat. 	The cloaking technology is built into the Peregrine's hull; it cannot be removed or transferred to another ship.

KGS Silver Albatross.name: KGS Silver Albatross
KGS Silver Albatross.description: Once they left human space, it became apparent to the Remnant that they would need to build their own shipyards in order to defend themselves if they were discovered by the Alphas or any other unfriendly faction. Using new composite materials that they discovered, they built ships very different from anything seen in human space.

KGS Silver Petrel.name: KGS Silver Petrel
KGS Silver Petrel.description: The Petrel is a multi-role mining/wing leader fightercraft designed to provide support for flights of lighter Terns in high-risk environments. The ship's design originated as an urban mobile gun platform that flitted around structures and natural terrain, but proved easy to adapt into a spacecraft. 	The Remnant are loath to sacrifice pilots and crew from the comparatively small pool they are drawn from. As such, their fighters are equipped with medium-range weaponry designed to strike enemies from afar. 	Fighters do not come equipped with a hyperdrive. You cannot carry a fighter unless you have a ship in your fleet with a fighter bay.

KGS Silver Smew.name: KGS Silver Smew
KGS Silver Smew.description: The Remnant have long favored turns of action that avoid putting crew directly at risk; though their Terns are a rather effective result of this ideology, the Remnant still had to face the fact that, eventually, one of their manned ships was going to end up too crippled to escape to safety. To that end, the Smew was developed; though quite lightly armed, Smews are capable of carrying a considerable quantity of cargo and passengers for a ship of their size, and are durable enough to absorb some fire from enemies while doing so. 	Though originally designed as lifeboats, the surprisingly mobile freighter-fighter hybrid has seen a remarkable amount of usage in mining fleets, as a way to supplement the otherwise poor cargo capacity of the Ibis. Because their purpose can vary from fleet to fleet, Smews are traditionally sold with a fair amount of free space: enough for a small weapon, upgraded engines, or additional support systems. 	Fighters do not come equipped with a hyperdrive. You cannot carry a fighter unless you have a ship in your fleet with a fighter bay.

KGS Silver Tern.name: KGS Silver Tern
KGS Silver Tern.description: The Tern is a small, hardy drone developed to plunge into the atmosphere of nearby gas giants for collecting valuable resources. These thick-shelled craft are also surprisingly effective when pressed into service as screening ships when enemies intrude into Remnant space. 	Unlike most spacefaring nations, the Remnant do not have enough people to pilot fighter wings in waves likely to sustain significant casualties. As such, they frequently use these hardy drones to fulfill similar screening roles in their home systems, allowing manned craft to focus on more specialized tasks. 	Drones do not come equipped with a hyperdrive. You cannot carry a drone unless you have a ship in your fleet with a drone bay.

KGS Rapid Stream.name: KGS Rapid Stream
KGS Rapid Stream.description: Developed after the Unfettered invasion, the Rapid Stream is a cut down Deep River, equipped with three turrets for extra defense from Unfettered Trackers.

KGS 1x1 VLS.name: KGS 1x1 VLS
KGS 1x1 VLS.description: Although the 9, 18, and 36 cell variants of the Avgi's Vertical Launch Array are by far the most common, their modular nature allows them to be easily made in all manner of odd sizes. This is the cell that all Avgi vertical launch systems are built from. Compatible with small-to-medium Avgi missiles, the cell's contents can be easily swapped to suit a given mission. This cell's negligible footprint makes it suitable for stuffing into nooks and crannies left over from other weapons. Sadly, the system still requires a turret mount. 	These tiny vertical launch cells enable versatile missile deployment, but as dual launchers and magazines, no separate missile storage is available. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS 1x2 VLS.name: KGS 1x2 VLS
KGS 1x2 VLS.description: This extremely tiny vertical launch system contains two independent launch cells, each occupying one ton of outfit space. Compatible with small-to-medium Avgi missiles, the cells' contents can be easily swapped to suit a given mission. This array's extremely compact footprint makes it even more suitable for drones and fighters than the four cell version, though the system still requires a turret mount. 	Vertical launch systems enable rapid and versatile missile deployment, but as dual launchers and magazines, no separate missile storage is available. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS 2x2 VLS.name: KGS 2x2 VLS
KGS 2x2 VLS.description: This very tiny vertical launch system contains four independent launch cells, each occupying one ton of outfit space. Compatible with small-to-medium Avgi missiles, the cells' contents can be easily swapped to suit a given mission. This array's very compact footprint makes it even more suitable for drones and fighters than the six cell version, though the system still requires a turret mount. 	Vertical launch systems enable rapid and versatile missile deployment, but as dual launchers and magazines, no separate missile storage is available. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS 2x3 VLS.name: KGS 2x3 VLS
KGS 2x3 VLS.description: This tiny vertical launch system contains six independent launch cells, each occupying one ton of outfit space. Compatible with small-to-medium Avgi missiles, the cells' contents can be easily swapped to suit a given mission. This array's compact footprint makes it even more suitable for drones and fighters than the nine cell version, though the system still requires a turret mount. 	Vertical launch systems enable rapid and versatile missile deployment, but as dual launchers and magazines, no separate missile storage is available. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS 3x4 VLS.name: KGS 3x4 VLS
KGS 3x4 VLS.description: This tiny vertical launch system contains twelve independent launch cells, each occupying one ton of outfit space. Compatible with small-to-medium Avgi missiles, the cells' contents can be easily swapped to suit a given mission. This array's compact footprint makes it suitable for drones and fighters, though the system still requires a turret mount. 	Vertical launch systems enable rapid and versatile missile deployment, but as dual launchers and magazines, no separate missile storage is available. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS 3x5 VLS.name: KGS 3x5 VLS
KGS 3x5 VLS.description: This tiny vertical launch system contains fifteen independent launch cells, each occupying one ton of outfit space. Compatible with small-to-medium Avgi missiles, the cells' contents can be easily swapped to suit a given mission. This array's compact footprint makes it suitable for drones and fighters, though the system still requires a turret mount. 	Vertical launch systems enable rapid and versatile missile deployment, but as dual launchers and magazines, no separate missile storage is available. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS 4x6 VLS.name: KGS 4x6 VLS
KGS 4x6 VLS.description: This small vertical launch system contains 24 independent launch cells in a rectangular array. Designed for flexibility, the system can employ a variety of small or medium-sized missiles. Owing to its large surface footprint, a turret mount is required for the launcher to deploy missiles safely. 	Vertical launch systems enable rapid and versatile missile deployment, but as dual launchers and magazines, no separate missile storage is available. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS 5x6 VLS.name: KGS 5x6 VLS
KGS 5x6 VLS.description: This small vertical launch system contains 30 independent launch cells in a rectangular array. Designed for flexibility, the system can employ a variety of small or medium-sized missiles. Owing to its large surface footprint, a turret mount is required for the launcher to deploy missiles safely. 	Vertical launch systems enable rapid and versatile missile deployment, but as dual launchers and magazines, no separate missile storage is available. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS 6x8 VLS.name: KGS 6x8 VLS
KGS 6x8 VLS.description: This medium vertical launch system contains 48 independent launch cells arrayed in parallel. A wide variety of small to mid-sized Avgi missiles are compatible with the launch cells, which can be easily interchanged. Designed for swift vertical cold-launch, the system needs an open space comparable to a turret mount to function properly. 	Vertical launch systems enable rapid and versatile missile deployment, but as dual launchers and magazines, no separate missile storage is available. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS 6x10 VLS.name: KGS 6x10 VLS
KGS 6x10 VLS.description: This medium vertical launch system contains 60 independent launch cells arrayed in parallel. A wide variety of small to mid-sized Avgi missiles are compatible with the launch cells, which can be easily interchanged. Designed for swift vertical cold-launch, the system needs an open space comparable to a turret mount to function properly. 	Vertical launch systems enable rapid and versatile missile deployment, but as dual launchers and magazines, no separate missile storage is available. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS 6x12 VLS.name: KGS 6x12 VLS
KGS 6x12 VLS.description: This large vertical launch system contains 72 independent launch cells in a rectangular formation. A variety of small and mid-sized Avgi missiles are compatible with the interchangeable launch cells. Designed for quick vertical launch, this system needs a turret mount for the required open space to function properly. 	Vertical launch systems enable rapid and versatile missile deployment, but as dual launchers and magazines, no separate missile storage is available. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS 9x12 VLS.name: KGS 9x12 VLS
KGS 9x12 VLS.description: This large vertical launch system contains 108 independent launch cells in a rectangular formation. A variety of small and mid-sized Avgi missiles are compatible with the interchangeable launch cells. Designed for quick vertical launch, this system needs a turret mount for the required open space to function properly. 	Vertical launch systems enable rapid and versatile missile deployment, but as dual launchers and magazines, no separate missile storage is available. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS 12x12 VLS.name: KGS 12x12 VLS
KGS 12x12 VLS.description: This huge vertical launch system contains 144 independent launch cells in a rectangular formation. The interchangeable launch cells are compatible with a variety of small and mid-sized Avgi missiles. Designed for speedy vertical launch, this system requires a large turret mount to function properly. 	Vertical launch systems enable rapid and versatile missile deployment, but as dual launchers and magazines, no separate missile storage is available. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS Twin Mandible Cannon.name: KGS Twin Mandible Cannon
KGS Twin Mandible Cannon.description: These two Mandible Cannons have been bolted together, creating a devastating long range weapon.

KGS Hyperpulse Cannon.name: KGS Hyperpulse Cannon
KGS Hyperpulse Cannon.description: The Hyperpulse Cannon is a more recent development of the Hai, a Pulse Cannon adapted to fire projectiles with much higher velocity, accuracy, and damage.

KGS Bipulse Ripper.name: KGS Bipulse Ripper
KGS Bipulse Ripper.description: The Unfettered have joined two Pulse Cannons, resulting in an effective and efficient weapon.

KGS Twin Railgun.name: KGS Twin Railgun
KGS Twin Railgun.description: The twin Skipper Railgun is favored by pilots who appreciate the ion and scrambling damage of the regular Skipper Railgun, but find it too small for use on ships larger than a drone. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS Triple Railgun.name: KGS Triple Railgun
KGS Triple Railgun.description: This weapon is, quite simply, the internals of three Skipper Railguns in a larger frame. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS Quad Railgun.name: KGS Quad Railgun
KGS Quad Railgun.description: Many captains have seen the power of the Skipper Railgun, and wanted a version fit for use on larger ships. This is the result - four Skipper Railguns in a larger housing. The recoil is intense. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS 2x3 Railgun.name: KGS 2x3 Railgun
KGS 2x3 Railgun.description: The recoil from this weapon probably renders reverse thrusters unnecessary. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS 3x3 Railgun.name: KGS 3x3 Railgun
KGS 3x3 Railgun.description: Only the most deranged of captains use these. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS 3x4 Railgun.name: KGS 3x4 Railgun
KGS 3x4 Railgun.description: The few captains who use these swear that flying backwards with them make engines unnecessary. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS 4x4 Railgun.name: KGS 4x4 Railgun
KGS 4x4 Railgun.description: The creator was drunk on acorn liquor when this was designed... 	Due to the huge fire rate, it was impossible to synchronize the firing of this weapon. As a result, it fires twice every shot. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS 4x5 Railgun.name: KGS 4x5 Railgun
KGS 4x5 Railgun.description: Why not? 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS Mini Blaster.name: KGS Mini Blaster
KGS Mini Blaster.description: The Energy Blaster has long been popular for its small size, allowing it to be stuffed almost anywhere. The Mini Blaster is an attempt to capitalize on this, featuring an even smaller footprint, but even more disappointing performance. 	As with the Energy Blaster, it is decently effective in large numbers.

KGS Particle Carronade.name: KGS Particle Carronade
KGS Particle Carronade.description: The Particle Carronade is a miniaturized Particle Cannon that fires smaller particle bolts, tuned for higher damage and a more rapid fire rate. Range and accuracy are reduced, but the small bolts allow for excellent velocity, and is thus a popular anti-fighter weapon.

KGS Particle Howitzer.name: KGS Particle Howitzer
KGS Particle Howitzer.description: The Particle Howitzer is a scaled-up Particle Cannon, firing larger particle bursts with higher velocity. It has better range and damage than the Particle Cannon, but fires more slowly, and is also much larger.

KGS Particle Burster.name: KGS Particle Burster
KGS Particle Burster.description: The pinnacle of pirate technology, the Particle Burster is a hodgepodge of two Particle Carronades and some Proton Gun components, among other various odds and ends. As its name suggests, it fires particle bolts in bursts, and is commonly found equipped on the flagships of various pirate warlords, for facing off with other gangs or the authorities. The bolts fired by this weapon are of lower accuracy and velocity than the Particle Carronade's, but are modified for more damage.

KGS Dual Particle Cannon.name: KGS Dual Particle Cannon
KGS Dual Particle Cannon.description: The Dual Particle Cannon is incredibly space-efficient for its firepower. However, it is less accurate, consumes more energy and creates quite a lot more heat than two Particle Cannons.

KGS Plasma Assault Repeater.name: KGS Plasma Assault Repeater
KGS Plasma Assault Repeater.description: The new main weapon of the Kingfisher fast heavy warship, the Plasma Assault Repeater is a Plasma Repeater adapted to fire in bursts. The modifications resulted in slightly increased overall damage, at the cost of increased energy use and heat generation.

KGS Particle Turret.name: KGS Particle Turret
KGS Particle Turret.description: The Lovelace Particle Turret is a new product designed for the heavy anti-capital role, mounting two powerful Particle Cannons on a rotating base. It has also become popular as an anti-fighter weapon for its excellent range and projectile velocity.

KGS Javelin Micro Pod.name: KGS Javelin Micro Pod
KGS Javelin Micro Pod.description: A Javelin Mini Pod cut down to just a single tube, the Javelin Micro Pod is so small it is almost useless. However, it can fit nearly anywhere. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS Javelin Launcher.name: KGS Javelin Launcher
KGS Javelin Launcher.description: This is simply two Javelin Pods welded together to fit in a single gun port. It is favored by captains who have sufficient space, but insufficient hardpoints to mount Javelin Pods. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS Javelin Storm Pod.name: KGS Javelin Storm Pod
KGS Javelin Storm Pod.description: The Javelin Mini Pod has long been a favorite of fighter pilots for its high damage and fire rate. The Javelin Storm Pod is a pair of Javelin Mini Pods welded together, but with a twist: it fires its eight tubes very, very rapidly, dealing great burst damage. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS Javelin Storm Launcher.name: KGS Javelin Storm Launcher
KGS Javelin Storm Launcher.description: The Javelin Storm Launcher, developed by Kraz Cybernetics for use on Tarazed's Kingfisher battlecruiser, fires all its 24 tubes very quickly, perfect for the Kingfisher's strike tactics. 	The weapon's extremely concentrated burst fire makes it almost impossible for anti-missile systems to counter all the missiles, ensuring that at least some of them hit. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS Javelin Strike Pod.name: KGS Javelin Strike Pod
KGS Javelin Strike Pod.description: The Javelin Strike Pod is a Javelin Mini Pod adapted to fire modified Strike Javelins - regular Javelins with a much larger propellant section. 	Unfortunately, the systems that enable the three-shot burst fire on the full-size launcher couldn't fit on this pod. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS Javelin Strike Launcher.name: KGS Javelin Strike Launcher
KGS Javelin Strike Launcher.description: The Javelin Strike Launcher is a Javelin Pod adapted to fire modified Strike Javelins - regular Javelins with a much larger propellant section. 	To maximize the chance of a hit at long range, this weapon has been adapted to fire in bursts of three. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS Javelin Micro Pod Deployer.name: KGS Javelin Micro Pod Deployer
KGS Javelin Micro Pod Deployer.description: The Javelin Pod's greatest strength is in its numbers, and thus this weapon exemplifies that further. Tiny Javelin Micro Pods, stripped down to the bare minimum loading magazine with small maneuvering thrusters for aiming correction, are launched in considerable number, providing a sustained fire rate equal to that of 6 Javelin Pods at the cost of massively increased tonnage overhead. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS Twin Gatling.name: KGS Twin Gatling
KGS Twin Gatling.description: These two Gatling Guns have been crudely joined to fit into a single gun port, offering twice as much damage but twice the power consumption and heat, along with a little bit of extra mass. However, it still needs to cool down for twice as long as it fires, and can only sustain a maximum of three seconds of continuous fire. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS Staggered Twin Gatling.name: KGS Staggered Twin Gatling
KGS Staggered Twin Gatling.description: These two Gatling Guns have been crudely joined to fit into a single gun port, offering twice as much damage but twice the heat and power consumption, along with a little bit of extra mass. However, an intricate mechanism staggers the fire of the two guns. It needs to cool down for half as long as it fires, and can only sustain a maximum of six seconds of continuous fire. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS Triple Gatling.name: KGS Triple Gatling
KGS Triple Gatling.description: These three Gatling Guns have been joined rather more nicely than the pirate-made Twin Gatling. An ingenious device staggers the fire of all three guns, allowing for sustained continuous fire. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS Quad Gatling.name: KGS Quad Gatling
KGS Quad Gatling.description: This scary weapon has been cobbled together from 4 Gatling Guns. Barmy Edward took inspiration from the Staggered Gatling Gun made and used by pirates, and this is the result - a weapon with huge damage potential, large enough to be used by capital ships. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS 2x3 Gatling.name: KGS 2x3 Gatling
KGS 2x3 Gatling.description: This absurd weapon was created by Barmy Edward. When asked why he designed it, he simply grins. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS Quad Gatling Turret.name: KGS Quad Gatling Turret
KGS Quad Gatling Turret.description: A pirate warlord has had two Staggered Twin Gatling Guns attached to a turret mount. Needless to say, the result is a terror, with a much faster cooldown time in between bursts than the original Gatling Turret. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS Gatling Snubnose.name: KGS Gatling Snubnose
KGS Gatling Snubnose.description: A creative pirate has chopped off most of the barrel of a Gatling Gun, resulting in a much lighter and faster firing weapon. However, the downsides are much diminished range, accuracy, and muzzle velocity, combined with a lower thermal limit and a hefty cooldown time. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS High Velocity Gatling Gun.name: KGS High Velocity Gatling Gun
KGS High Velocity Gatling Gun.description: A creative pirate has gone in the opposite direction of the Gatling Snubnose, and has instead lengthened the barrel of the Gatling Gun, resulting in higher muzzle velocity and accuracy. The longer barrel also results in a higher thermal limit and more effective cooling, allowing it to fire continuously, though at a lower rate because of the increased barrel weight. 	Ammunition for this weapon can be restocked at any outfitter.

KGS Twin Flamethrower.name: KGS Twin Flamethrower
KGS Twin Flamethrower.description: The already-fearsome Flamethrower has been made doubly scary with this twinned version. Two Flamethrowers have been joined in a fashion that allows for slightly better fuel efficiency at the cost of heat.

KGS Strike Javelin.name: KGS Strike Javelin
KGS Strike Javelin.description: The Strike Javelin missile is ammunition for the Javelin Strike Launcher; without a launcher to store them in you cannot purchase or use Strike Javelins.

KGS Strike Javelin Storage Crate.name: KGS Strike Javelin Storage Crate
KGS Strike Javelin Storage Crate.description: The Strike Javelin Storage Crate is used to store extra ammunition for Javelin Strike Launchers.

KGS Javelin Micro Pod Package.name: KGS Javelin Micro Pod Package
KGS Javelin Micro Pod Package.description: This package is a stripped-down Javelin Micro Pod, with a minimized loading magazine holding 6 Javelins, and a few small chemical thrusters for aiming. The Javelin Micro Pod Package is ammunition for the Javelin Micro Pod Deployer; without a deployer to store them in you cannot purchase or use Javelin Micro Pod Packages.

KGS Javelin Micro Pod Storage Rack.name: KGS Javelin Micro Pod Storage Rack
KGS Javelin Micro Pod Storage Rack.description: The Javelin Micro Pod Storage Rack is used to store extra ammunition for Javelin Micro Pod Deployers.

KGS Binary Repeater.name: KGS Binary Repeater
KGS Binary Repeater.description: Two Thermal Repeaters have been wired together, resulting in rather insane heat output.

KGS Double Digger Mining Beam.name: KGS Double Digger Mining Beam
KGS Double Digger Mining Beam.description: These two Digger Mining Beams have been stacked. Some clever engineering allows it to be slightly more effective than two separate beams, at the cost of a requiring little more energy and making a little more heat.

KGS Double Digger Mining Turret.name: KGS Double Digger Mining Turret
KGS Double Digger Mining Turret.description: The complement to the Double Digger Mining Beam, this handy turret, originally meant for asteroid mining, is actually quite effective against ships due to its shield disruption capabilities.

KGS Twinhibitor.name: KGS Twinhibitor
KGS Twinhibitor.description: Simply two Inhibitor Cannons in a single frame, this weapon is favored by Remnant captains trying to fit the maximum number of the long-range, slowing weapons as possible on their ship.

KGS Bithrasher.name: KGS Bithrasher
KGS Bithrasher.description: The Bithrasher was created when several Remnant captains expressed dissatisfaction because filling their ships with Thrasher Cannons left a lot of weapon space free.

KGS Trithrasher.name: KGS Trithrasher
KGS Trithrasher.description: The Trithrasher is for captains who want even more than the Twin Thrasher. It does incredible damage up close, especially against hull.
